name: FloodSense
problem: Village roads and residential areas get flooded during heavy rainfall and monsoon seasons.
solution_description: An IoT-based flood monitoring system using water-level sensors, GIS mapping and predictive analytics to provide early warnings.

name: Smart Irrigation System
problem: Farmers face water shortages and inefficient irrigation causing crop losses.
solution_description: A smart irrigation platform using soil sensors, IoT devices and automated water management.

name: AirWatch
problem: Urban areas experience high levels of air pollution affecting public health.
solution_description: An air quality monitoring network using environmental sensors, cloud analytics and predictive models.

name: WaterSafe
problem: Communities lack access to clean drinking water and face contamination issues.
solution_description: A water quality monitoring solution using IoT sensors and real-time contamination analytics.
